preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of operations is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range of node numbers.
Each operation specifies two distinct nodes within the range of node numbers.
The input graph is an undirected tree.

postconditions.expression: Output is a list of n integers
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of n integers, where the i-th integer represents ci.

postconditions.expression: ci is the count of distinct j such that lists of node i and node j share at least one number
postconditions.description: For each node i, ci is calculated as the number of nodes j (where j ≠ i) such that the lists of node i and node j contain at least one common number.
